scope: Read-only local account/CLI inspection and primary-source research; no native UI test or provisioning

localFindings.interpretation: Installed CLI self-report and account presence; not an independent security audit or background-GUI proof

findings.claim: Muse's documented OS sandbox contains shell filesystem/network operations; account roles and background Windows GUI guarantees remain unspecified in reviewed primary docs
Configured MCP servers do not inherit shell containment; SDK page examples identify Muse1.3.0
Meta computer-use protocol requires caller-owned environment/driver/capture
Windows Child Sessions are a supported loopback-session mechanism
Power Automate PiP child session demonstrates concurrent main-desktop use and physical automation; Home explicitly unsupported. Its virtual desktop mode excludes physical input/screenshots

correction: A second profile is possible and useful for command isolation. It does not alone provide full background TRACE Computer Use. Same-PC GUI operation has additional session/VM approaches worth evaluating.
